memberships.page_title: A Cubic-Jet Rank Obstruction to Further Homogeneous Descent

statement: The unique scalar-monomial quadratic shift lowering the cubic jet from rank seven to six is P2=-d^2 e_a, and its quartic error is detected by an exact 13-term functional outside the cubic homological image; the natural quadratic target cleanup also fails.
